verdict.line: You lose if Urgot lands Disdain on you at level 3 or 6 and chains it into Echoing Flames and Fear Beyond Death; you win if you survive those two windows and scale into your crit items.

brief.thesis: Urgot is a ranged poke-and-burst duelist whose E (Disdain) catch chains into passive flame procs and, from level 6, a global execute — that produces two sharp, discrete kill windows rather than constant pressure. Outside those windows Gangplank's own ranged Q trades and W sustain let him play even, and the head-to-head data (48.6% GP win rate over 1519 games, lane EVEN but solo-kill edge to Urgot) reflects exactly that: defensive, not losing.

theirWindow.when: Right after E (Disdain) lands on you
theirWindow.what: He stops on the catch and chains autos/W (Purge) to trigger Echoing Flames procs; at level 6 he follows with R (Fear Beyond Death) to set up the execute. Back off immediately instead of trading through it.

yourWindow.when: Right after his E (Disdain) whiffs or is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Disdain is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s on cooldown by rank — with no other dash, he can't disengage or re-catch you. Step up and trade with Q (Parrrley) or all-in while it's down.

start.why: 48.2% win rate over 1272 games and the standard 71.1% pick — the extra AD and sustain let you trade Q (Parrrley) into his poke without losing the HP race before level 6.

boots.why: 48.7% win rate, 41% pick — flat physical reduction blunts his autos, Echoing Flames procs, and Purge channel, all of which are physical damage.

core.why: Mana sustain and AD let you spam Q (Parrrley, 5s cooldown) in trades without running dry, and it's the first item in the highest-winrate path (54.8% over 241 games).
Execute threshold synergizes with your own all-in burst once Urgot is low from poison stacks and Q resets.
Completes the 54.8%-winrate path — crit scaling is where you pull ahead of him in the late-game power curve.

situational.when: he or the enemy team starts stacking armor or health tank items
his Q (Corrosive Charge) poke is wearing you down too hard pre-6 and you need lifesteal sustain
you need extra burst or a dash to punish him right after Disdain goes on cooldown

runes.keystoneWhy: Its damage-over-time stacks with your Grog-Soaked Blade poison during extended trades, punishing him for standing in Q (Parrrley) range to poke back.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 88.4% of games at 48.5% win rate — Flash dodges or resets the level 3/6 Disdain all-in, and Ignite denies his sustain and secures the kill once he commits.

playing.title: Track Disdain's cooldown out loud
playing.detail: 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s by rank with no backup dash — once it's down, he has no way to catch or escape you, so that's your trade window.

playing.title: Respect levels 3 and 6 specifically
playing.detail: These are his two scripted kill windows (E into Echoing Flames, then R execute at 6). Don't overextend into his E (475) or Q (800) range on these levels even if the wave looks free.

playing.title: Poke with Q, not autos
playing.detail: Parrrley's 625 range lets you contest his ranged kit without walking into auto-attack range where Echoing Flames builds up on you.

playing.title: Hold W for his Corrosive Charge slow
playing.detail: Remove Scurvy clears CC and heals — save it to cleanse his Q slow mid-chase rather than burning it reflexively on cooldown.

playing.title: Freeze near tower before level 6
playing.detail: Denying easy Disdain setups in the 3-6 window matters more than farming aggressively; push harder once you've survived his first ult-enabled all-in.

playing.title: Use R globally once he's immobile
playing.detail: Cannon Barrage has 20000 range — punish his lack of a second dash by zoning him off objectives or finishing him in skirmishes he can't escape.

playing.title: Scale into crit items before forcing fights
playing.detail: You're the better champion past level 12 with Essence Reaver into Infinity Edge online — avoid forcing all-ins before your core completes.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the ability timings, kill-window reads, and trade patterns are my own tactical analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Use Grasp of the Undying and [Q] to contest lane and gain control over lane easily. However be careful of being hit with (E)-(P) during level 3 and 6 as he can kill you then.
